# Local operational derivative

All 92 blobs at kayhide/tree-sitter-idris revision
9fe334fb603fdce0e84349ed78f41ae3d2f7036b remain byte exact under upstream/.
The upstream package metadata names a different repository; the local package
uses the actual authenticated source origin without modifying original metadata.
Generated ABI14 parser tables, node inventory and Unicode predicates are pristine.

The active scanner is the separately observed fixed-storage C derivative. Tokens
retain complete UTF-8 up to the declared 1024-byte storage boundary; two uint32
stacks and a versioned 1024-byte snapshot refuse excess rather than truncate.
Restore is transactional and fully reset. Accepted scalar/state steps consume
finite credit. Cancellation, allocation, invalid scalar, embedded NUL and
ownership failure prevent native admission; capacity/work alone may authenticate
exact-source fallback. The optional upstream DEBUG paths are unsupported and
must remain disabled; normal builds do not define either debug macro.

The Rust callback lifecycle is adapted from the existing owned Rc Sed host.
Namespace, static parser inventory and contract metadata change; status9 is
explicit UnsupportedNul. No third-party source is fetched or generated at build.
The fixed Rc owner still uses stable infallible allocation and is not a hard
memory guarantee. Scanner steps do not measure total parser work or RSS.

Eleven isolated local C commands passed 63 direct controls and nine native cases,
including the complete original, BOM geometry, no-op and recovery after refusal.
That evidence is not Rust, reusable runtime, semantic IR, whole-language or
empty-cache network-denied qualification. Idris evaluation, named application
normalization, dependent-type resolution and unsupported syntax remain unknown.

A bounded constant-state trial commits only a valid enabled native symbol after
a clean scope poll. Declined/refused trials preserve payload and result symbol;
Tree-sitter remains responsible for native lexer cursor rollback. Eight added
C controls and the unchanged nine native cases passed on this exact successor.
